turn.user_message: A normal Tuesday: doctors decide anywhere from 6 to 9 PM, depending on the consultant. They sign around 11. Papers ready 12:30, bill final 1:30, insurance approves around 2:30, patient leaves 3:15, bed ready 4:30.
turn.context: Discharge sample conversation, turn 12 (playbook §6: say what shifted, recompute, name what holds).

transcript.label: Sample conversation · turn 12 · your real times

text: Your real times change the picture a little, and mostly in a useful way. Two of my guesses held up. One was wrong in a way that helps.
The decision time is not fixed. It moves with each consultant. So the trial should start with the consultants who decide latest, because their patients lose the most of the evening.
chat.invite: Shall I update the trial plan with these times?
chat.note: The latest decisions lose the most time.

blocks.caption: All seven times are yours. The gaps are worked out from them.

sheets.title: Doctor decides
sheets.text: The decision starts everything. If nobody writes it down, say so.

sheets.title: Doctor signs
sheets.text: The morning signature. Today every paper waits for it.

sheets.title: Papers ready
sheets.text: When the summary is ready to hand over.

sheets.title: Bill final
sheets.text: When the final bill is closed.

sheets.title: Insurance approves
sheets.text: For insured patients only. When the insurer says yes.

sheets.title: Patient leaves
sheets.text: When the patient leaves the ward.

sheets.title: Bed ready again
sheets.text: When the bed is clean and ready for the next patient.

blocks.label: What your times changed

items.line: Not a fixed 7 PM. It depends on the consultant.
The bed sits empty after the patient leaves.

blocks.caption: Muted, because these are your facts. Nothing in this row is my proposal.

sheets.title: Doctors decide 6 to 9 PM
sheets.text: The unused hours overnight are 14 to 17, not 16. Patients of late deciders get the least time, so the trial starts with those consultants.

sheets.title: Papers take 1½ hours
sheets.text: This is the typing step the software removes. It was the biggest hold-up I expected, and your times agree.

sheets.title: Bed ready 75 minutes later
sheets.text: Part of this may be waiting for housekeeping to hear. We will check it in the trial.

blocks.label: Hours each patient waits
blocks.sub: Your times. I had 5 hours. The yearly cost moves from ₹10.3 crore to ₹10.9 crore, the most it could be.
